cves.headline: AWS Security Agent MCP server before 0.2.0 can leak scanned workspace source archives

name: Unverified Ownership
title: CWE-283: Unverified Ownership
ai_text: In AI software this weakness shows up in MCP servers, the connector layer that AI agents use to reach tools and data. The one CVE here is in the AWS Security Agent MCP server before version 0.2.0, where scanned workspace source archives can leak. The server does not properly check that the caller asking for a resource is the entity that owns it, so a request for a scanned archive can be served to the wrong party. That lets an attacker pull source archives belonging to another workspace, exposing private code and scan results. The product named in the CVE is the AWS Security Agent MCP server.
description: The product does not properly verify that a critical resource is owned by the proper entity.

mitigations.description: Very carefully manage the setting, management, and handling of privileges. Explicitly manage trust zones in the software.
Consider following the principle of separation of privilege. Require multiple conditions to be met before permitting access to a system resource.

consequences.note: An attacker could gain unauthorized access to system resources.
